apkClosure.signatureMethod: Alpine APK signatures verified by apk verify against the key embedded in the exact pinned architecture-specific base image; apk add re-verifies during installation.

recipe.preSmokeVerification: Create a stopped container from the built image, copy /lib/apk/db/installed without starting it, and require exact equality to finalInstalledInventory.
recipe.nativeArchitectureRequirement: Docker daemon architecture, runner architecture, and image architecture must all match the target; QEMU emulation is not accepted.
recipe.targetSmokeNetwork: The smoke runs with ordinary job networking for frozen Bun dependency installation and the pinned public OMP release download. The runtime image build and APK installation are network-disabled; no network-isolated smoke claim is made.

review.coverage: Bounded to the pinned Alpine runtime inventory and the recorded advisory-source snapshot; this does not establish absence of every vulnerability.
